trace.notes: Normalized the single input as a zbMATH resolver URL with trailing identifier 1779807. Direct shell fetching was unavailable in the Codex CLI sandbox because DNS resolution failed; browser/web lookup of the zbMATH record did not expose a readable document body.

Local collected zbMATH metadata and publisher/author bibliographic pages identify the exact work as Tomas Caraballo and Jose Antonio Langa, "On the Theory of Random Attractors and Some Open Problems," in Stochastic Partial Differential Equations and Applications, Lecture Notes in Pure and Applied Mathematics 227, pages 89-104, 2002. The Routledge/CRC page confirms the book table of contents but exposes only metadata, description, and table-of-contents text, not the chapter body.

Failure mode: metadata_only/paywalled_or_restricted, with local network_or_dns_failure for shell fetches. Bounded exact-work recovery used the exact zbMATH identifier, exact title searches, title plus PDF searches, the Routledge/CRC landing page, Taylor & Francis eBook leads, author publication pages, Perlego/Pageplace previews, and the visible DOKUMEN preview. The publisher and author pages were bibliographic only; the commercial ebook route required access; the preview sources exposed only table-of-contents or partial/non-authorized fragments and not a confirmed complete chapter body containing the open-problem section. No readable exact-work PDF or complete HTML technical source was recovered.
